npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-01.html.text: Magister Xenovia: I am very busy with my magical experiments. I cannot even obtain the materials I need... Forgive me, but would you mind coming back later?

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-07.html.text: Magister Xenovia: I will give you the encoded document if you make the 3 Dark Oxides with materials you find on your own using my equipment. It is very difficult to produce the Dark Oxides successfully because the process is very complicated. And if you fail, you will be responsible for the cost of…

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-02.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Here for the sword of the Goddess' secret document? I never heard of it...

links.text: I heard everything from Warehouse Keeper Cluck.

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-11.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Ah! I see that you have brought the Dark Crystal... I will give you 3 solutions. You can continue the experiment by choosing one of them. You will need 5 Dark Crystals for each experiment. One of the 3 solutions will be able to produce Dark Oxide. Please choose carefully...

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-10.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Go to Alligator Beach and hunt Crokians, Dailaons, Crokian Warriors and Farhites , and bring me the Dark Crystals you collect there. You need at least 5 in order to conduct a single experiment. If the experiments are successful, you can acquire Dark Oxides . Bring me 3 Dark Oxides…

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-15.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Thanks to your efforts, I was able to get all the materials I needed. I am in your debt, my friend!

Q00345_MethodToRaiseTheDead/30912-01.htm.text: Magister Xenovia: I'm afraid I can't tell you much about that Medium Jar, not that you are the first to inquire about it... Some fellow from the Dark Elven village was asking questions about it a while back. I'm of the opinion that the urn's abilities have been vastly over-stated in these wild rumo…

links.text: "I wish to use the Medium Jar."

Q00345_MethodToRaiseTheDead/30912-06.htm.text: Magister Xenovia: Were the results what you expected? I feel I must warn you, it's not healthy for Humans to spend so much time with the dead. It tends to color your outlook. By the way, if you want to get rid of all those useless Bone Fragments you should sell them to Mad Doctor Orpheus . He can b…

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-03.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Hmm... Well, since you heard it from Kluck, I guess I have no choice. Kluck never gives up! Actually, this document has long vexed me. I'm not even interested in the sword granted by Eva, but I need that document to further my magical research...

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-04.html.text: Magister Xenovia: The data that I require for my magic research is closely linked to that encoded document. Of course, if I had the actual material that I need, I wouldn't need to consult the document...

links.text: "Then if I bring you the material, would you give me the document?"

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-05.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Hmm... I need that material on a continuing basis, unfortunately. If I were to give you the document, I would be severely limiting my options. Perhaps...how about this? Help me produce 3 Dark Oxides, which are created by putting certain chemicals on a Dark Crystal.

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-06.html.text: Magister Xenovia: I will give you the encoded document if you make the 3 Dark Oxides with materials you find on your own using my equipment. It is very difficult to produce the Dark Oxides successfully because the process is very complicated. And if you fail, you will be responsible for the cost of…

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-08.html.text: Magister Xenovia: I will prepare 3 solutions if you bring me the Dark Crystal. One of the 3 solutions will be able to produce the Dark Oxide. Unfortunately, I cannot yet produce perfect solutions every time. What you will need to do is choose one of these 3 solutions and then place 5 Dark Crystals …

links.text: "I see. Where can I get the Dark Crystal?"

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-09.html.text: Magister Xenovia: Go to Alligator Beach and hunt Crokians, Dailaons, Crokian Warriors and Farhites . Bring me the Dark Crystals you collect there. You need at least 5 in order to conduct a single experiment. If the experiments are successful, you can acquire Dark Oxides . Bring me 3 Dark Oxides and…

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-12.html.text: Magister Xenovia: (The Dark Crystal dissolves in the solution. The mixture begins to bubble. Suddenly, something emerges from the bubbles... The experiment was a success!)

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-13.html.text: Magister Xenovia: (The mixture begins to bubble. Suddenly, something emerges from the bubbles... The experiment was a success!) Excellent! We have 3 Dark Oxides... Thank you. Thanks to your help, I no longer need the Cryptogram of the Goddess Sword. Take it with my gratitude!

Q00140_ShadowFoxPart2/30912-14.html.text: Magister Xenovia: (The Dark Crystal dissolves in the solution. The mixture begins to bubble. But nothing else happens. The experiment was a failure!)

Q00345_MethodToRaiseTheDead/30912-02.htm.text: Magister Xenovia: Well, we certainly aren't trying to keep anyone from using the urn that wants to... I suppose you will be wanting to summon a departed one's soul? I'm sorry, my friend, but the powder you need will not come for free... It may not look like much, but it is the property of the guild…

Q00345_MethodToRaiseTheDead/30912-03.htm.text: Magister Xenovia: That's what I like! A plain speaker! Now put this powder into the medium jar along with the bones you have. I fear that the results may be other than what you expect...

Q00345_MethodToRaiseTheDead/30912-04.htm.text: Magister Xenovia: You talk the talk but your wallet is weak. Come back when you have more adena.

Q00345_MethodToRaiseTheDead/30912-05.htm.text: Magister Xenovia: Whatever. Come back if you change your mind.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30912-note.text: Magister Xenovia: There is no way that I'll teach you any Dark Elven magic. I would consider teaching some other kills, but I'm very busy right now. Why don't you come back laster?

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30912.html.text: Magister Genovia: True, there's a lot of clamoring these days about the return of Shilen. Those claiming to be her "children" stir up trouble everywhere, it seems. Yes, we Dark Elves call ourselves her children as well, but not in the same sense. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
